assumptions: A applies to every newly configured product task; historical tasks and template fixtures need an explicit compatibility policy in abc-01.
A fixed Python runner with fresh phase workers is the planned baseline; no automatic model escalation or parallel subagents are assumed.
Generic release/deploy adapters use explicit project destinations; no real production target is inferred for these tooling repositories.
Each implementation package is independently releasable with backwards-compatible opt-in until complete A/B/C activation.
Until the new release engine exists, future task releases use the existing verified local release procedure and record evidence manually.
One branch/worktree per task; same workspace across model and phase switches
One canonical repository control state and one writing owner per task
Serial integration/version/publication per release channel with final-candidate proof
Cleanup is a separate recoverable step and cannot duplicate publication
Relevant skills selected by task/risk; required lifecycle and evidence remain enforced
